answer_1.quote: We evaluate our two optimized algorithms on automatic speech recognition (ASR) and summarization tasks... For summarization, we use the test portions of Extreme Summarization (Xsum) and CNN/Daily Mail (CNN/DM) to evaluate the quality of summaries generated by language models with ROUGE-1.
answer_1.outputs: Generated speech transcriptions for ASR and textual summaries for summarization
